title: UPSC PRATIBHA Setu Portal 2026: Details, Candidate Profiles & Employer Registration Process
summary: UPSC PRATIBHA Setu (formerly Public Disclosure Scheme) connects verified employers, PSUs, and ministries with non-recommended willing candidates who cleared all stages of UPSC exams. Registration and details available online.
content:
Quick Overview: UPSC PRATIBHA Setu (formerly Public Disclosure Scheme) connects verified employers, PSUs, and ministries with non-recommended willing candidates who cleared all stages of UPSC exams. Registration and details available online.

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has launched the UPSC PRATIBHA Setu (Professional Resource And Talent Integration Bridge for Hiring Aspirants) portal, formerly known as the Public Disclosure Scheme (PDS). This initiative provides a second gateway for UPSC aspirants by enabling verified private sector organizations, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), central ministries, and autonomous bodies to access candidate profiles.

The portal features profiles of over 10,000 talented candidates who cleared all written and interview stages of UPSC competitive examinations (including CSE, CDS, GEOL, CMS, CPF, ISS, and IES) but did not make the final merit list. Employers can seamlessly register using their Corporate Identification Number (CIN) and directly connect with top national talent.

1. Important Dates & Schedule

EventDate / Schedule
Portal StatusActive & Live
Available Profiles UpdateCDS II 2025, GEOL 2025, CMS 2025, CPF 2024, CDS I 2025, CSE 2024, ISS 2025, IES 2025
Registration ModeOnline via UPSC Portal (upsconline.gov.in)

2. Vacancy, Educational Qualification & Pay Scale

Post / CriteriaDetails
Target Candidate Pool10,000+ candidates who appeared in UPSC Interview/Personality Test
Exams IncludedCivil Services Exam (CSE), CDS, Combined Geo-Scientist (GEOL), CMS, CAPF (CPF), ISS, IES
Educational QualificationAs per respective UPSC examination eligibility criteria (Graduate / Post Graduate / Technical degree)

3. Age Limit & Category-Wise Application Fee

Criteria / CategoryDetails
Age CriteriaAs per candidate's respective UPSC recruitment notification rules
Registration FeeNil / Free Registration

4. Selection Process

✔ Stage 1: Candidate qualifies all written stages and Personality Test/Interview of respective UPSC exam

✔ Stage 2: Candidate opts in for Public Disclosure under PRATIBHA Setu scheme

✔ Stage 3: Employer/Organization registers via CIN MCA API verification

✔ Stage 4: Employer browses candidate profiles, wishlists, shortlists, and initiates hiring/selection

5. Step-by-Step How to Apply / Download

Step 1: Open the official UPSC portal www.upsc.gov.in and click on the 'Examination' menu on top bar.

Step 2: Click on 'UPSC PRATIBHA Setu' from the drop-down list to access https://upsconline.gov.in/miscellaneous/pdoiac/

Step 3: Click on 'Register', enter your organization's Corporate Identification Number (CIN), and click 'Verify'.

Step 4: Enter the OTP sent to the email address registered with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) and click 'Submit'.

Step 5: Fill in the Nodal Officer Registration form details upon successful OTP verification and click 'Submit'.

Step 6: Enter the verification OTP received on the Nodal Officer's mobile number and email address.

Step 7: Access the UPSC PRATIBHA Setu Dashboard to view notifications, candidate soft biodata, wishlist, and shortlist top talent.

title: IBPS CRP PO/MT-XVI & Specialist Officers (SPL-XVI) Recruitment 2026 Notification
summary: Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the window notification for CRP PO/MT-XVI and CRP SPL-XVI for vacancies of 2027-28 in participating public sector banks. Online registration is open from 01.07.2026 to 21.07.2026.
content:
Quick Overview: Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the window notification for CRP PO/MT-XVI and CRP SPL-XVI for vacancies of 2027-28 in participating public sector banks. Online registration is open from 01.07.2026 to 21.07.2026.

Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has officially released the schedule for the Common Recruitment Process (CRP) for Recruitment of Probationary Officers / Management Trainees (CRP PO/MT-XVI) and Specialist Officers (CRP SPL-XVI) for vacancies of 2027-28 in Participating Public Sector Banks. Interested candidates planning to join public sector banks as PO/MT or SO can register online via the official website www.ibps.in.

The detailed notification containing post-wise vacancy breakdown, eligibility criteria, educational qualification, and fee structure will be published on the official IBPS portal. Candidates must ensure they meet the minimum eligibility requirements prior to submitting their online application form.

1. Important Dates & Schedule

EventDate / Schedule
Online Registration Start Date01.07.2026
Online Registration & Fee Payment Last Date21.07.2026
Edit/Modification WindowAfter closure of Registration (To be notified on official website)
Pre-Exam Training (PO/MT)August 2026
Online Examination – Preliminary (PO & SO)August 2026
Result of Preliminary ExamSeptember 2026 (PO) / September-October 2026 (SO)
Online Examination – MainOctober 2026 (PO) / November 2026 (SO)
Declaration of Main Exam ResultNovember 2026
Personality Test (PO/MT)November 2026
Conduct of InterviewNovember / December 2026
Provisional AllotmentJanuary 2027

2. Vacancy, Educational Qualification & Pay Scale

Post / CriteriaDetails
Probationary Officers / Management Trainees (CRP PO/MT-XVI)Graduation Degree in any discipline from a recognized University / Institution
Specialist Officers Cadre Posts (CRP SPL-XVI)Relevant Professional Degree (Engineering/IT, Agriculture, Law, HR, Marketing, Rajbhasha, etc.)

3. Age Limit & Category-Wise Application Fee

Criteria / CategoryDetails
Age Limit (PO/MT & SO)20 to 30 years (Standard IBPS criteria, relaxation applicable as per rules)
Application FeeTo be specified in detailed notification (Payable Online between 01.07.2026 and 21.07.2026)

4. Selection Process

✔ Stage 1: Phase 1: Online Preliminary Examination

✔ Stage 2: Phase 2: Online Main Examination

✔ Stage 3: Phase 3: Personality Test / Common Interview

✔ Stage 4: Phase 4: Document Verification & Provisional Allotment

5. Step-by-Step How to Apply / Download

Step 1: Visit the official IBPS portal at www.ibps.in.

Step 2: Click on the link for CRP PO/MT-XVI or CRP SPL-XVI on the homepage.

Step 3: Select 'Click here for New Registration' and enter your basic details to generate Registration ID and Password.

Step 4: Fill out the online application form with complete personal, educational, and category details.

Step 5: Upload scanned copies of Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Handwritten Declaration as per instructions.

Step 6: Pay the required Application Fee through online mode (Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI).

Step 7: Submit the application form and download/print a copy of the submitted application form for future reference.

title: IBPS SO Recruitment 2026 (CRP SPL-XVI): Apply Online for Specialist Officer Posts
summary: IBPS has released the notification for Common Recruitment Process CRP SPL-XVI for Specialist Officers Scale-I posts across 11 participating public sector banks. Online registration is open from July 1, 2026, to July 21, 2026 at www.ibps.in.
content:
Quick Overview: IBPS has released the notification for Common Recruitment Process CRP SPL-XVI for Specialist Officers Scale-I posts across 11 participating public sector banks. Online registration is open from July 1, 2026, to July 21, 2026 at www.ibps.in.

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has officially announced the notification for the Common Recruitment Process for Recruitment of Specialist Officers (CRP SPL-XVI) for vacancies of 2027-28. This national-level recruitment drive invites eligible Indian citizens to apply for Specialist Officer Scale I posts across 11 Participating Public Sector Banks, including Bank of Baroda, Punjab National Bank, Canara Bank, Indian Bank, and Union Bank of India.

The recruitment process consists of two online examinations—Preliminary and Main Examination—followed by a Common Interview conducted by the Participating Banks and coordinated by the Nodal Bank. Provisionally allotted candidates will receive a basic pay scale of ₹48,480 to ₹85,920 plus applicable allowances as per bank rules.

Application Modification Edit Window2 days after registration closing

Online Preliminary ExaminationAugust 2026
Declaration of Preliminary ResultSeptember / October 2026
Download Call Letters for Online Main ExamOctober 2026
Online Main ExaminationNovember 2026
Declaration of Main Exam ResultNovember 2026
Conduct of Common InterviewNovember / December 2026
Provisional AllotmentJanuary 2027

2. Vacancy, Educational Qualification & Pay Scale

Recruitment PostsIT Officer (Scale I), Agricultural Field Officer (Scale I), Rajbhasha Adhikari (Scale I), Law Officer (Scale I), HR/Personnel Officer (Scale I), Marketing Officer (Scale I)

3. Age Limit & Category-Wise Application Fee

4. Selection Process

✔ Stage 1: Online Preliminary Examination

✔ Stage 2: Online Main Examination

✔ Stage 3: Common Interview (conducted by Participating Banks and coordinated by Nodal Bank)

✔ Stage 4: Provisional Allotment to one of the Participating Banks based on merit-cum-preference

5. Step-by-Step How to Apply / Download

Step 1: Visit the official IBPS portal at www.ibps.in.

Step 2: Click on the registration link for 'CRP-SPL-XVI Specialist Officers'.

Step 3: Click on 'Click here for New Registration' and enter basic details such as name, contact information, and email address.

Step 4: Log in using the generated Registration Number and Password.

Step 5: Fill in personal details, educational qualifications, post preference, and bank preferences accurately.

Step 6: Upload scanned copies of Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Hand-written Declaration according to prescribed standards.

Step 7: Pay the application fee / intimation charges online via Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.

Step 8: Submit the final application form and keep a printed copy of the application confirmation page for future reference.

title: IBPS PO / MT XVI Mains Result 2026 Released: Check Online Main Exam Status
